name: wrapped_quantized_linear_prepacked
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::_wrapped_quantized_linear_prepacked(Tensor input, Tensor input_scale, Tensor input_zero_point, Tensor packed_weight, Tensor output_scale, Tensor output_zero_point, int out_channel) -> Tensor. Tests cover leading batch dimensions, contiguous and noncontiguous inputs/weights, empty batches, zero output or inner dimensions, native CPU reference comparison for the opaque packed ABI, and vector-input rejection.
